tools.name: timetableos_check_key
tools.description: Show the business this API key belongs to and what the key may do (its scopes and locations). Needs no scope. Use it first to test a key. API: GET /ping.

tools.name: timetableos_list_members
tools.description: List members of the studio. Filter by name, email, phone or member number (q), status, tag, home location or changes since a time. Needs members:read. API: GET /members.

tools.name: timetableos_get_member
tools.description: Get one member by id: name, contact details, status, home location, tags and join date. Needs members:read. API: GET /members/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_memberships
tools.description: List memberships, the plans members hold. Filter by member, status or plan. Needs memberships:read. API: GET /memberships.

tools.name: timetableos_get_membership
tools.description: Get one membership: its plan, status, price, billing dates and visits left. Needs memberships:read. API: GET /memberships/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_plans
tools.description: List membership plans and passes the studio sells (price, billing, visits). Needs plans:read. API: GET /plans.

tools.name: timetableos_get_plan
tools.description: Get one membership plan: price, signup fee, billing interval and eligible locations. Needs plans:read. API: GET /plans/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_classes
tools.description: List the classes, appointments, workshops and open-access offers of the studio. Needs classes:read. API: GET /classes.

tools.name: timetableos_get_class
tools.description: Get one class: duration, capacity, drop-in price and waitlist setting. Needs classes:read. API: GET /classes/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_sessions
tools.description: List scheduled sessions (occurrences) of the classes in a time window, with capacity, booked count, spots left and waitlist. Needs classes:read. API: GET /occurrences.

tools.name: timetableos_get_session
tools.description: Get one scheduled session: class, start and end, room, instructor, capacity and spots left. Needs classes:read. API: GET /occurrences/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings (reservations) by session, member or status. Needs bookings:read. API: GET /reservations.

tools.name: timetableos_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking (reservation): session, member, status and check-in time. Needs bookings:read. API: GET /reservations/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices by status, kind, membership, member or due date. Read only: no payment or refund. Needs invoices:read. API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: timetableos_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice: amount, tax, due date, payment status and failure reason. Read only. Needs invoices:read. API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_list_products
tools.description: List shop products (retail items) with price and stock. Needs products:read. API: GET /products.

tools.name: timetableos_get_product
tools.description: Get one shop product: name, SKU, price, stock and locations. Needs products:read. API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_create_member
tools.description: Create a member (a lead, prospect or active member) in the studio. Writes a record. Needs members:write. API: POST /members.

tools.name: timetableos_update_member
tools.description: Change fields of one member: contact details, status, home location or tags. Only the fields you pass change. Needs members:write. API: PATCH /members/{id}.

tools.name: timetableos_book_member
tools.description: Book a member into a scheduled session, with the front desk rules (capacity, waitlist, blocking flags, entitlement). A visit that would need payment is refused. Needs bookings:write. API: POST /reservations.

tools.name: timetableos_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking (reservation), with an optional reason. Cancels the seat for the member. Needs bookings:write. API: POST /reservations/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: timetableos_record_check_in
tools.description: Record a member check-in at the door, kiosk or app. Returns whether the check-in is allowed and why not if it is not. Needs checkins:write. API: POST /check-ins.

tools.name: timetableos_capture_lead
tools.description: Capture an enquiry as a lead, the same way the studio's website form does. Needs leads:write. API: POST /leads.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: timetableos_list_members, timetableos_record_check_in · Private data: timetableos_check_key, timetableos_get_member, timetableos_create_member, timetableos_update_member, timetableos_record_check_in · Public sink: timetableos_list_members, timetableos_create_member, timetableos_book_member, timetableos_cancel_booking, timetableos_record_check_in, timetableos_capture_lead · Destructive: timetableos_get_class.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: timetableos_list_members, timetableos_record_check_in · Private data: timetableos_check_key, timetableos_get_member, timetableos_create_member, timetableos_update_member, timetableos_record_check_in · Public sink: timetableos_list_members, timetableos_create_member, timetableos_book_member, timetableos_cancel_booking, timetableos_record_check_in, timetableos_capture_lead · Destructive: timetableos_get_class

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
